# Required assets

<!-- Generated by `npm run assets`. Edit src/lib/data, not this file. -->

**149 files**: 96 music stems across 6 scenes, plus 53 ambience beds. Paths assume `assetLayout({ base: "/audio", ext: "ogg" })`.

## Format

| | |
|---|---|
| Container | **Ogg Vorbis** (`.ogg`) for everything. See the note on MP3 below. |
| Sample rate | 48 kHz, or 44.1 kHz — one or the other throughout. |
| Channels | Stereo for music and wide beds; mono is fine for point sources. |
| Music level | Mix each stack as a whole, around −18 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. |
| Bed level | Normalise each bed to about −20 LUFS. The console applies −18/−12/−6 dB on top. |
| Bed length | 30–90 s. Give beds in the same scene different lengths so they do not lock into a pattern. |

Loops are played with `loop = true`, which is sample-exact and does no crossfading — the file itself has to loop cleanly. **Avoid MP3 for music stems**: the encoder adds padding at both ends that survives decoding, so the loop drifts off the bar grid and clicks once per pass. Ogg Vorbis, Opus and WAV do not. If you need a Safari fallback, serve `.m4a` from `resolveSrc` by feature test and accept it for beds only.

## Music

Every stem of a scene starts on the same sample and runs for the life of the scene; intensity and mode only move gain. So all stems of one **variant** — both stacks — must be the same length, at the same tempo, bounced from one session with layers soloed. Layer 1 is heard alone at intensity 1; each further layer is added on top.

| Scene | Tempo | Key | Loop | Stems |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hypersleep Bay | 60 BPM | D minor | 8 bars · 32.00 s | 12 |
| The Derelict | 66 BPM | C minor | 8 bars · 29.09 s | 16 |
| Colony Habitat | 84 BPM | A minor | 8 bars · 22.86 s | 16 |
| The Hive | 72 BPM | F minor | 8 bars · 26.67 s | 20 |
| Storm Surface | 78 BPM | G minor | 8 bars · 24.62 s | 16 |
| Med Lab | 90 BPM | B minor | 8 bars · 21.33 s | 16 |

## Producing this in order

1. **Explore layer 1 for each scene** (6 files). Every scene plays at intensity 1. This is the smallest thing that is worth demoing.
2. **Scene beds** (36 files, some shared). This is where most of the atmosphere lives.
3. **Explore layers 2..n** — intensity starts working.
4. **Combat stacks** — the combat toggle starts working.
5. **Second variants**, then the rest of the bed library.

Until a file exists, keep it out of the resolver so the console stays quiet about it: `assetLayout({ base, ext, available: urlsYouHaveUploaded })` returns `null` for anything not in the set, and `missingAssets(config, uploaded)` tells you what is still outstanding.
